universalAnswers.whatHappened: Four subscribers filed a September 18 complaint alleging an agreement to slow AI development.
universalAnswers.plainLanguageIdentity: A dated complaint report, not a court decision or customer notice.
universalAnswers.evidenceLimits: The filing establishes what plaintiffs alleged and requested, not agreement, unlawfulness, class certification, relief, or later case status.
universalAnswers.readerRelevance: Subscribers can distinguish an allegation from an account change or court order.
universalAnswers.affectedPeople: The four named plaintiffs, the four named defendant companies, and the proposed group described in the complaint; filing does not make every subscriber a class member.
universalAnswers.changesNow: The complaint was filed September 18; this report describes that filing only.
universalAnswers.uncertainty: Whether the alleged agreement occurred, was unlawful, or produces relief is not decided by filing.
universalAnswers.readerAction: Before acting on a legal headline, identify whether it describes a complaint, an order, or a direct customer notice.
universalAnswers.betterQuestion: What did the filing allege and request, and what later document would actually decide it?

legal-policy.legalStatus: A private proposed class-action complaint filed September 18 in the Northern District of California.
legal-policy.jurisdiction: United States District Court for the Northern District of California, San Francisco Division.
legal-policy.parties: Four named subscribers sued Anthropic, OpenAI OpCo, SpaceXAI and Google.
legal-policy.allegationVsFinding: Plaintiffs allege an agreement restrained competition; the complaint is not a finding that it happened or was unlawful.
legal-policy.currentEffect: Filing records claims and requests but does not itself change subscriptions, certify a class, grant damages, or impose an order.
legal-policy.unresolvedQuestions: Whether an agreement occurred, whether it violates law, whether a class will be certified, and whether any relief is granted.
legal-policy.nextMilestone: A later court filing or order would be needed for a later-status report.

translation.newsVersionExact: Four paying AI subscribers filed a proposed class-action complaint on September 18 against Anthropic, OpenAI OpCo, SpaceXAI and Google.
translation.actualMeaningExact: A filing records that allegation; it does not decide whether an agreement happened, whether it was unlawful, or what remedy would follow.
translation.mechanismExact: The plaintiffs allege the companies agreed to slow improvements to competing AI products, reducing the value of subscriptions people had already bought.
translation.familiarExampleExact: A claim that they agreed together to close early is a different claim.

jargon.plainMeaning: a request to bring one case for a larger group
the area of law the plaintiffs invoke in arguing that the alleged agreement restrained competition

learningConnections.learningPayoff: Shows how to separate a sourced claim from the larger conclusion a headline invites.
